task.description:

Check:

(b) Does it specify exact SQL for the new conn.exec in appendEventInTx?
(c) Does it specify the exact change to TC-SCH-02-03?

(c) PASS — TC-SCH-02-03 additional pre-seed INSERT into plat_event_idempotency specified with exact SQL, binding (&.{conflicting_idem}), and placement (after events insert, before pollDueTimers). (d) PASS — files NOT to change listed with rationale: migrations/1147, other migrations, src/store/event_store.zig, build.zig, build.zig.zon. (e) PASS — no function bodies, no SQL DDL, no JSX; code fragments are precision-specification only, not implementation. (f) PASS — all decisions resolved; BACKEND-DEV can implement directly.
